description: The steps of a flow, with current, done and pending states.

howToUse: Use it at the top of a flow split into steps that follow an order: sign-up, checkout, onboarding.
Pass the `steps` and the `current` one. By default people can go back to done steps but not skip ahead; `allowFutureNavigation` lets them.
Give the flow a `label` ("Create account"), which is announced with the progress. On narrow screens it turns compact by itself.
Check the fields of a step before moving on: the stepper does not validate.
alternatives: Questions asked one at a time: Questionnaire.
Areas with no order: SettingsSubnav or Tabs.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the steps people can open.
Goes to the first or last of them.

props.name: variant
props.description: `auto` goes compact through a container query; the other options force the layout.

props.description: By default only completed steps and the current one can be opened.
